use_terms: FRED public data (Board of Governors H.15); citation required, redistribution of derived research series inside this private repo only.
adjustment_method: Constructed constant-maturity 13-week T-bill roll: weekly log return = prior Friday DGS3MO/52 - 0.25y * weekly DGS3MO change, Friday samples, holiday Fridays use the prior observation (<=7d). Same convention as emfin_v2/toolbox/moneymarket.py. Validated against BIL ETF when network available.
